title.zh: 将三宝颜市Pasobolong的棉兰老中央疗养院更名为三宝颜区域医疗中心的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Mindanao Central Sanitarium in Pasobolong, Zamboanga City to Zamboanga Regional Medical Center
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Mindanao Central Sanitarium in Pasobolong, Zamboanga City to Zamboanga Regional Medical Center

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2025/ra_12117_2025.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Mindanao Central Sanitarium in Pasobolong, Zamboanga City is hereby renamed to Zamboanga Regional Medical Center.
All laws, executive orders, issuances, and rules and regulations inconsistent with this Act are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
